title: Response Models
description: Control what data is returned to the client using response models.

slides.title: Why Response Models?
slides.content:
# Filtering Output

Response models let you specify the structure of the response. They can:

- Exclude sensitive data (like passwords).
- Add computed fields.
- Provide automatic documentation.

Use the `response_model` parameter in route decorators.

```python
from pydantic import BaseModel

class UserOut(BaseModel):
    username: str
    email: str
    # no password field

@app.get("/users/{user_id}", response_model=UserOut)
def get_user(user_id: int):
    # internal user object may have password
    return {"username": "alice", "email": "alice@example.com", "password": "secret"}
```

The password is automatically filtered out.
